## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; mixed internals with cyclicals (Energy/Industrials/Materials) strong while Tech and Financials lag, creating conflicting signals—confirmations: (a) 7/11 positive breadth vs concentrated big-cap divergences (MSFT, JPM weak while DE, OXY, FCX strong); (b) Top performers span multiple sectors but large-cap Tech/Financials show persistent BELOW TREND readings. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TRA ND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: Tech (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -8.41%) with MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND and ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft overall (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -2.70%) with JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and AXP (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style tilting Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CVS (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -10.64%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND, USB (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -5.47% | 1M: +11.09%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Financial names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (AAPL/NVDA vs MSFT/JPM) — tactical setups, not unanimous market confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -8.41%) with pockets of strength: AAPL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, but MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND and INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND—sector internally rotating.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are mixed/soft (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -2.70%) with PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY and CME (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.84%) ABOVE TREND offset by JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and AXP (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND — look for selective opportunities rather than broad exposure.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows patchy support (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +1.36%) with JNJ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND while UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.92%) RECOVERY; sector is a mix of defensive strength and stock-specific risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor cyclicals and energy exposure (OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging large-cap Tech/Financial names (MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -6.98% | 1M: -11.39%) BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical favored amid rotation; monitor big-cap divergences for regime tilt.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY — M&A chatter; OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND — momentum; ASML (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND — negative guidance, at risk; MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +11.63%) — breadth supportive; Industrials (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +9.03%) — leading names ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -8.41%) and Financials (1W: -1.89% | 1M: -2.70%) — watch for further dispersion among mega-caps.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND for hold above recent 1W gains as confirmation; AAPL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND — sustained strength would validate Tech bounce; MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND — failure to narrow 1M loss signals continued underperformance; OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND — retest of breakout would favor cyclical continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (+80): Stripe talks on potential PayPal deal — price RECOVERY (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) confirming short-term accumulation. AMD (+80): Meta chip deal — AMD (1W: +5.30% | 1M: -17.65%) RECOVERY confirming news-driven bounce. WMT (+80): buyback and e‑commerce strength — WMT (1W: -1.63% | 1M: +7.66%) CORRECTION (news bullish but 1W softness = watch for follow-through). FCX (+60): extended Grasberg rights — FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-55): lowered expectations — UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND confirming downside risk. LLY (-55): pricing pressure from Novo Nordisk — LLY (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.92%) RECOVERY but news is a headwind (divergence). DE (-50): sales outlook concerns — DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND (news bearish but price strong → divergence, monitor for distribution). TSLA (-50): Europe sales slump — TSLA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND confirming weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with a Value/Cyclical tilt as cyclicals and energy lead while Tech and Financials lag. OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps (MSFT, UNH BELOW TREND vs AAPL, NVDA ABOVE TREND) and mixed news flow (PYPL/AMD confirming while UNH/LLY headline risk persists).
